decision.observation: Hornet stands on the mossy ledge beside the shell-patterned rubble bank; the ceiling above is solid moss. On the left wall hang several drooping grey stone-cone clusters, with a small green glow dot above them (~0.42, 0.21) and another at the far-left edge (~0.00, 0.47). decision.hypothesis: The drooping grey stone-cone clusters on the left wall resemble the climbable stone clusters used on right walls elsewhere. Jumping up-left onto them may reach an upper mossy ledge or hidden passage near the green glow dot.
decision.memory: This mossy rubble chamber: ceiling solid; left wall stone-cone clusters are the most climbable-looking feature.
